name: sip-android
description: Native Android build of the Sip hydration tracker (web code lives in ../hydration)

scripts.prepare:web: rm -rf www && cp -r ../hydration www && rm -f www/sw.js && cp node_modules/@capacitor/core/dist/capacitor.js www/
scripts.sync: npm run prepare:web && cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
